issues.quote: I was one floor below the atelier with a bottle and a dead man's watch in my pocket, and I am the heir.
issues.fact: The only watch the transcript places in Félix's pocket is his late father's silver watch. The sheet does not say which watch or whose it is.
issues.misreading: 'A dead man's watch' could be read as the uncle's watch, since the uncle is the deceased. A solver could then attach a reading to the uncle's watch when the sheet only supports the father's silver watch.

issues.quote: He made it for the new century. He told everyone so, and he made sure everyone heard about the four years of it.
issues.fact: The sheet gives no duration for making the repeater and says nothing about when it was made.
issues.misreading: 'Four years' suggests a timespan a solver could use as a clue, but the sheet provides no such fact.
